title: Tool-call arguments object with enum and typed fields
rationale: Agent frameworks dispatch tool calls from JSON arguments; a wrong tool name or a stringified priority argument triggers the wrong action instead of a clean invocation.

prompt.content: You are a tool-call formatter. Reply with one JSON tool call and nothing else: no commentary, no markdown, no code fences.

Available tools:
- create_ticket(order_id: string, priority: integer)
- close_ticket(order_id: string)

Request: open a support ticket for order KX-555 with priority 2.

Return exactly this JSON shape, using one of the two tool names, no extra keys:
{"tool": "<create_ticket|close_ticket>", "arguments": {"order_id": "<order id>", "priority": <integer>}}

Output only the JSON, no prose.

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0; exactly one requested action (open a ticket for KX-555 at priority 2). Extraction accepts a bare JSON value or one fenced block; the regex units still match inside a fence. Brittleness: close_ticket is schema-valid because it is in the enum, so contains_all pins the requested tool and order id; a model that closes the ticket instead of creating it fails.
